findings.reason: the four test rewrites are the deliverable's riskiest edit and the change is a one-line done-when addition (run the four staying tests) plus widening the grep pattern to the bare module names, without which the gate cannot show the conversion worked.
findings.text: §4's done-when checks that "its moved tests pass from their new location" but never that the four tests that STAY in tests/ and that the deliverable rewrites (test_a_lift_reaches_every_budget_row.py, test_ledger_files_and_index_agree.py, test_writer_callers_first_wave.py, test_timestamp_callers_batch_a.py) still pass, and the done-when's grep pattern `reckon\.crew\.(carryover_census|death_census|pace_replay)` cannot see those files' imports, which are all written in the bare-name form `from reckon.crew import carryover_census, death_census` (test_ledger_files_and_index_agree.py:12), `from reckon.crew import pace_replay` (test_a_lift_reaches_every_budget_row.py:31) and `from reckon.crew import carryover_census` (test_writer_callers_first_wave.py:283) — so a botched importlib-by-path conversion of any of the four passes every stated measure (moved tests pass, grep clean, ratchet passes) while the test actually fails at collection

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — the four named test files, the two research scripts, the three census modules and every cited plan link resolve; extensionless hrefs resolve as `<path>.html`.
rubric_items.done_when: a finding — §4's done-when verifies only the moved tests, never the four tests that stay in tests/ and are rewritten, and its dotted-path grep cannot see their `from reckon.crew import ...` imports.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the plan's gate logs and evidence land on the repository's durable evidence path (docs/evidence/archive/nothing-lands-unreached-landed.html, which resolves), not a session or node-local scratch path.
rubric_items.naming: pass — no plan labels, stage names, ticket numbers or version tags reach new symbols; the only identifiers carrying ordinal-like text (test_writer_callers_first_wave.py, test_timestamp_callers_batch_a.py) are existing cited filenames, not names this plan introduces.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — §4's mechanism (move to scripts/census/, add an argparse main behind a __main__ guard, load the four staying tests by path) can produce its done-when; its root cause (unreached, evidence-producing modules) matches §1's reach graph; and the only production locus referencing the three modules is reckon/budget.py:2651, which is in §4's declared write paths, so the mechanism runs where the plan says it does.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — each section names one deliverable (§4: move the three census modules out of the package).
rubric_items.wiring: pass — §4's ordering (after §3, itself after §2) is stated in the section text and in f-nlu-002, and the plan's only cross-plan relation (the g-tcirbn-reach-instrument gate on the-codebase-is-reviewed-between-nodes §6) is explicitly disclaimed by the plan-standalone meta and resolves on that plan.
